name: Suryo Foods & Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, Suryo Foods & Industries Ltd is in the business of shrimp hatchery and other sea products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SFIL operates a shrimp hatchery at Gopalpur and is also engaged in real estate development on its vacant land in Dhamara, Odisha. It imports shrimps screened by government quarantine for diseases. The production process involves advanced water treatment (chlorination, filtration, UV, and ETS drainage) and includes units for maturation, hatching, spawning, LRT & PCRT, supported by Artemia, algae, and a PCR lab. The final Port Larval Seed is supplied to farmers.
